title: Decide whether to retain speculative durable graph adapter work
description: Decision requested: remove this speculative implementation task from the backlog and keep the durable-backend refusal/write-ownership contract for a future concrete adapter. No shipped durable GraphStore exists and the original entry explicitly said not to design its write API speculatively. Recommendation: archive as not planned until an adapter proposal exists; no release action required.

title: Decide whether public identifiers need a type-prefix migration
description: Decision requested in #213: retire the blanket public type-prefix migration unless a concrete remaining consumer collision justifies breaking identifiers. Typed graph, vectors, metadata and current exports now preserve the known identities. Recommendation: close the design proposal as not planned and reopen only with a reproducible unresolved collision. Not a release blocker; maintainer approval is pending.

title: Decide whether to deprecate unsupported extractor selection
description: Decision requested: implement extractor selection or deprecate the no-op config.extractors accessor. Current non-default settings warn and the canonical configuration guide clearly says selection is not implemented. Recommendation: deprecate through a compatibility cycle in a separate issue rather than add partial-extraction semantics before release. Do not remove the accessor or change full/incremental coverage until the choice is approved.

title: Decide whether to retire unsupported eval confirmation scaffolding
description: Decision requested: retire unused eval/confirmation scaffolding or retain it with an explicit future support plan. console_eval remains unregistered in every supported packaged mode. Recommendation: inventory callers and remove the unused surface in a dedicated cleanup instead of hardening a feature the product does not expose. Preserve private review boundaries; do not create a public vulnerability report for a latent unsupported path. No removal has been performed.
